games.name: Sworn
games.description: Edit currencies and resources for your Sworn save files

seo.title: Sworn Save Editor - Edit Currencies, Achievements & Resources
seo.description: Free online Sworn save editor. Modify your gold, crystals, achievements, and progression. Works in your browser with no downloads. Supports v1.0.1.0.1018.

faq.question: How do I find my Sworn save file?
faq.answer: On Windows, your Sworn save file is located at %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Windwalk Games\SWORN\data\[STEAM_ID]\. Look for files named savegame_*.dat

faq.question: Is this Sworn save editor safe to use?
faq.answer: Yes, the editor runs entirely in your browser. Your save file never leaves your computer - all processing happens locally.

faq.question: Can I edit Sworn currencies like gold and crystals?
faq.answer: Yes, you can edit all currencies including gold, crystal shards, fairy embers, grailwater, moonstone, and silk.

faq.question: Will editing my Sworn save file get me banned?
faq.answer: Sworn is a single-player/co-op game. Save editing is for personal use and does not affect other players.

platforms.name: Steam
platforms.instructions:
Put the following into your file explorer to go straight to the Save Game folder, then click on the folder with your Steam ID:
%USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Windwalk Games\SWORN\data\. Drag the latest file named: savegame_12345678.dat into this editor to begin
platforms.notes: Always create a backup of your save file before editing. The save file is named with your Steam ID followed by a number.

faq.question: How do I find my Megabonk save file?
faq.answer: On Windows, your Megabonk save file is at %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Ved\Megabonk\Saves\CloudDir\[STEAM_ID]\progression.json

faq.question: Is the Megabonk save file encrypted?
faq.answer: Yes, Megabonk uses AES-256-CBC encryption. This editor automatically handles decryption and re-encryption.

faq.question: Can I unlock all characters in Megabonk?

faq.question: Will my Megabonk achievements sync after editing?
faq.answer: In-game achievements will reflect your edited save. Steam achievements may require meeting the actual conditions.

faq.answer: Cloverpit uses a custom XOR cipher. This editor automatically decrypts and re-encrypts your save file.

games.name: Balatro
games.description: Edit money, chips, unlocks, and progression in your Balatro save files

seo.title: Balatro Save Editor - Edit Money, Chips & Unlocks
seo.description: Free online Balatro save editor. Modify money, chips, joker unlocks, and meta progression. Handles profile.jkr compression automatically. Supports v1.0.1.

faq.question: Where are Balatro save files stored?
faq.answer: Windows: %APPDATA%\Balatro\1\profile.jkr. Mac: ~/Library/Application Support/Balatro/1/. Linux: ~/.local/share/Balatro/1/

faq.question: What is a .jkr file?
faq.answer: The .jkr format is Balatro's compressed save format using DEFLATE compression with Lua table serialization.

faq.question: Can I unlock all jokers in Balatro?
faq.answer: Yes, you can edit meta progression to unlock jokers, decks, and other content.

platforms.name: Steam
platforms.instructions:
Windows: %APPDATA%\Balatro\1\
Mac: ~/Library/Application Support/Balatro/1/
Linux: ~/.local/share/Balatro/1/

Look for profile.jkr (or meta.jkr for meta progression) and drag it into this editor.
platforms.notes: Always create a backup of your save file before editing. The save file is compressed with DEFLATE and uses Lua table serialization.

site.name: EditMySave
site.description: Edit your game save files directly in your browser. Free, secure, and easy to use. No downloads required.

faq.question: Is EditMySave free to use?
faq.answer: Yes, EditMySave is completely free. There are no hidden fees, subscriptions, or premium features.

faq.question: Is EditMySave safe?
faq.answer: Yes, all save file processing happens locally in your browser. Your files never leave your computer and are never uploaded to any server.

faq.question: Do I need to download anything?
faq.answer: No, EditMySave works entirely in your web browser. No downloads, installations, or plugins required.

faq.question: Will editing my save files get me banned?
faq.answer: EditMySave only supports single-player and co-op games. Editing saves for personal use in these games does not affect other players.

faq.question: What games does EditMySave support?
faq.answer: We currently support Sworn, Megabonk, Cloverpit, Balatro, BALL x PIT, and Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor, with more games coming soon.

faq.question: How do I find my save file?
faq.answer: Each game editor includes instructions for locating your save file. Generally, save files are in %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\ or %APPDATA% on Windows.
